text:
alex r.: heads-up — hit a weird handoff window on staging when control-plane flakes. node A started demote, node B accepted handoff, then control-plane came back and both think they own the prefix for ~200ms :grimacing:

alex r.: repro (reduced):
```
# node A (demote) -> send HTO(epoch=42, fence=1) to node B
# node B (accept) -> write residency=owner, reply ACK
# control-plane reconnects, notices lease-alarm -> tries fast-recover and reassigns same prefix to A before B cleared its in-memory residency
# result: routing layer briefly routes to A while B still serves KV for cached prefixes -> 5xx for some reads that hit cached hotkeys
```

maria t.: ugh. is the ACK durable? did B persist anything we can use to detect double-ownership? :thinking:

alex r.: B persisted an epoch marker to local metadata but because control-plane took a diff path it created a new global lease record pointing to A. so the single-source-of-truth (control-plane) disagreed with local runtime state. we lack a quick reconciliation handshake between runtime and control-plane on reconnect.

jon s.: couple of thoughts: 1) add an observerless two-phase fence: demote publishes fence+intent to nearby replicas (not central cp), wait for quorum ACKs, then flip local residency. 2) keep a short soft-grace period where both nodes serve reads but B serves strictly from prefix-local LRU (no writes/backfills). 3) on control-plane reassign, require cp to validate active epoch(s) via a quick lease probe to current owner before assigning.

maria t.: i like 2 for quick wins. soft-grace lets us avoid transient 5xx. for long term, 1 is safer but ops-heavy. can we implement 1 without touching cp? maybe piggyback on existing raft lease metadata?

jon s.: piggyback possible if we add a tiny per-prefix raft entry (epoch,fence,handshake-id). node making demote appends entry; other replicas ack. cp can still reassign but will observe latest raft entry and avoid racing. downside: raft churn + more metadata writes on handoffs.

alex r.: tradeoffs sound reasonable. short-term action items: implement soft-grace read-only window (30-200ms) configurable per-tenant, add metric "handoff_conflicts" and a smoke test that simulates cp blip and ensures no 5xx spike. long-term: spike a prototype for raft-piggyback handshake in a spike PR.

handoff-bot: created ticket RW-ops/hand-off-grace-window with checklist, assigned to @alex r. and @jon s. :white_check_mark:

maria t.: sweet. i'll add a canary test in the prefetcht harness too. :thumbsup:
